Overview Of The Company
 OMV Petrom is the largest energy company in South-Eastern Europe, being active on every aspect of the energy value chain: from wells, producing oil and gas, to refining and fuels distribution, gas supply and power generation & supply. We provide the energy for day-to-day modern life: fuels for mobility, light and heat. We believe that we can only evolve with a diverse mix of employees and by ensuring a healthy work-life balance.
Our Business | OMVPetrom.com
At OMV Petrom, we have a long tradition of responsible behavior towards employees, the environment and society. Sustainability means a focus on conducting the business responsibly, efficiently and in an innovative way. We are committed to create long-term value for the company and our stakeholders, while respecting the environment and, supporting the communities in which we operate.

 Your tasks
Extract, transform, and load data from various company source systems (e.g., SAP, TM1). 
Model, implement, and develop reporting and data analysis solutions, including data visualizations and reusable data models.
Produce and integrate data from multiple sources to proactively identify trends and opportunities for reporting process improvement.
Meet with report beneficiaries to clarify and document reporting requirements. 
Monitor the reporting process to identify opportunities for automation.
Provide reporting services such as manual data uploads and interventions to ensure accuracy and completeness of reporting.
Collaborate with technical partners to review code structures and request feedback. 
Analyse and implement pilot programs and operational activities related to data analytics.
 Your profile
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, finance, data analytics, applied mathematics, statistics, engineering, economics, or similar field
Relevant professional experience: > 7 years
Advanced proficiency with BI Tools (e.g. Power BI, DAX) and data visualization best practices
Strong Python skills for implementing business logic and analytical models
Proficiency documentation solutions (e.g. GitHub)
Experience with SQL, T-SQL, MDX, tabular models, and data modeling in enterprise environments 
Proficiency in BI applications (SAP Cloud Analytics, SAP BO, Microsoft BI, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, IBM Planning & Analytics, OneStream) 
Advanced knowledge of MS Office, databases, and infrastructure applications (Windows SharePoint/Portal Services) 
Understanding of data engineering concepts, including ETL and pipeline integration 
Data modeling, database development, and data mining techniques 
Statistical modeling and hypothesis testing 
Knowledge of performance reporting frameworks (e.g., KPIs, financial metrics)
English on an advanced level (written, spoken, conversation)
 What OMV Petrom Can Offer You

Additional days off and various financial support for different events like marriage, child birth, etc.
Access to LinkedIn Learning and a variety of development programs.
